release_notes: Ban 0.0.19: 3 bo loc (Trang thai HD / Ket qua kiem tra / Mau so HD) duoc GUI LEN CONG THUE khi ban chon dung 1 ma moi o, nen hoa don chua tung tai cung hien ra. Cu phap da do that: dang 'tthai==1'; cong chi nhan MOT gia tri moi dieu kien nen chon nhieu ma thi loc tai may. Neu cong tu choi dieu kien (HTTP 400/422/500) app tu lui ve tai du roi loc tai may va bao ro trong thong bao ket qua — khong bao gio mat hoa don vi bo loc. Sua 2 loi do ra soat doc lap: nhanh may tinh tien khong con xoa dau 'cong tu choi loc', va khong con cau 'da tai DU' khi lan dong bo con thieu du lieu.
